summary: Round r1 (restricted network). The 16B note on 'unverified reports of a request to extend the LDC preparatory period' is now traceable to dated UN primary leads: the CDP Crisis Assessment of Nepal (July 2026, UN DESA) reviewing Nepal's May 2026 request, and the ECOSOC 2026 management segment record (E/2026/L.24 and the related ECOSOC decision, July 2026) which, per the lead descriptions, took note of the CDP conclusion and referred the final decision to the General Assembly. No UNGA resolution granting the extension was located; secondary sources describe it as pending before the Second Committee of the 81st session. Therefore, as of this round, the confirmed graduation date remains that set by A/RES/76/8 (November 2026, to be verified from the resolution text), and the extension is requested and recommended-for-decision but not decided. The Smooth Transition Strategy (NPC) and its implementation review (ESCAP) were located. All items remain pending retrieval.

findings.claim: Q1 Currently scheduled graduation date under GA resolution A/RES/76/8 and the length of the preparatory period granted in 2021.
findings.note: Retrieve resolution text C02 (verify symbol) and C01/C04/C03; record adoption date and scheduled date.

findings.claim: Q1 Status of Nepal's 2026 request to extend the preparatory period: CDP conclusion and conditions, ECOSOC action, and UNGA decision.
findings.note: CDP crisis assessment C07 and ECOSOC 2026 management segment C08 (E/2026/L.24 and adopted decision) establish the CDP and ECOSOC steps. UNGA decision: no primary document located; secondary sources (C19, C20) indicate it was pending and scheduled for the Second Committee of the 81st session. As of 2026-09-27 the confirmed date remains the one set by A/RES/76/8 until the GA acts.

findings.claim: Q1 Smooth transition strategy: adoption date, pillars, implementation status and the CDP-requested time-bound reprioritisation plan.
findings.note: STS text C14/C15; UN record C16; implementation review C17; CDP conditions C07. A revised/reprioritised STS document has not been located.

findings.claim: Q1 CDP monitoring reports on Nepal during the preparatory period (enhanced monitoring mechanism).
findings.note: CDP annual reports C09 (E/2022-2026/33 series) monitoring chapters; not located as direct files.

findings.claim: Graduation date is treated as a two-branch scenario variable until a GA resolution is retrieved: branch G26 (graduation on the date set by A/RES/76/8) and branch G29 (extended date requested by Nepal). No probability is assigned to either branch.
Only UN primary documents (GA resolutions, ECOSOC decisions, CDP reports/assessments) establish status; news items are recorded for chronology only and cannot confirm a decision.

data_gaps: UNGA resolution or decision on Nepal's extension request - not yet located (likely not yet adopted as of 2026-09-27; Second Committee scheduled in the 81st session).
Text of the ECOSOC decision adopted in July 2026 (symbol and paragraph) - landing page located only.
Nepal's formal request letter to the CDP/UN (May 2026) - not located as a document; described in C07.
Revised/reprioritised STS demanded by the CDP - not located.
CDP monitoring reports on Nepal 2022-2025 - not located as direct files.

assumptions.text: Two-branch treatment of the graduation date (G26 per A/RES/76/8, G29 per the extension request) without probabilities until the GA acts.

challenges.text: The extension request is no longer only 'unverified reports': CDP crisis assessment (L52/C07) and ECOSOC 2026 records (C08) are primary leads. What remains unverified is the GA decision. EXP-13 should carry graduation date as a dated event attribute with both branches.

Escalation: scenario and strategy conclusions that assume loss of LDC preferences/S&DT from late 2026 may change if the GA grants the extension; affected: EXP-13 timing, 26B S&DT timelines, preference-erosion channels.

Escalation for red-team review: if the GA grants the extension, check whether CDP conditions (time-bound STS reprioritisation plan) create new commitments to track in the international-commitment register; if it does not act before the scheduled date, graduation takes effect under A/RES/76/8.

uncertainty: High on timing. The CDP and ECOSOC steps are documented by primary leads (not yet retrieved); the GA outcome is unknown at 2026-09-27. Dates cited in this finding are drawn from document titles/descriptions and must be verified against retrieved texts.
